billable | non_billable. Task_Map.billable_type always equals the linked Activity_Types.billable_type. It is the Billable/Non-Billable setting for NEW time going forward only. It must NOT be used to convert or overwrite the billable flag on past time entries.

Benton's rule (2026-11-13): historical time entries KEEP their original billable/non-billable flag as recorded; if something was non-billable in the past it stays non-billable. ONE exception: any historical entry whose ORIGINAL logged names contain "Partner" (case-insensitive) must be billable. Match only on the names stored on the original entry (old task, old role, old department, or project/task name in the time entry). Do NOT use the new mapped activity type for this (e.g. old "Onboarding" mapped to "Partner Onboarding" keeps its original flag). Such entries currently marked non-billable are a known user error (people forgot to tick billable) and should be corrected.

Do not bulk-update. 1) Scan all historical entries (~25,000 rows) and select those where any ORIGINAL name on the entry (task, role, department, or project/task name as logged) contains "partner" (case-insensitive), AND the entry is currently non-billable. Task_Map.historical_billable_rule = force_billable marks the old Department/Role/Task rows that meet this; still check each entry's own logged names, since entries may carry project or description names not in Task_Map. Never use new_activity_type for this test. 2) Produce a reviewable change list with columns: entry_id, date, person, hours, department, role, task_or_activity, old_flag, new_flag (=billable). 3) Benton reviews/approves the list. 4) Only then apply the changes, logging each change (entry_id, old_flag, new_flag, changed_at, approved_by). Every other historical entry keeps its original flag.

keep_original = past entries for this old task keep their recorded billable flag; force_billable = the ORIGINAL old_task, old_role or old_department name contains "Partner" (case-insensitive); the new mapped activity type is ignored. Past entries on these rows must be billable (correct non-billable ones via the reviewed change list in rule:historical_billable_process). Applies to historical data only.
